guidance: This operation timed out and the process was killed. For long-running work, retry with background=true: the call returns immediately with a job_id, the work runs asynchronously (ceiling 3600s), and the result lands in the notifications pool -- read it with notifications_check. Add notify_telegram=true (or notify_resend=true) to be pushed a message when it finishes. Do not simply retry with a longer timeout.
